author: matichek
description: Galactic War only. Your commander, fabbers, factories, and missile launchers build 100x faster. Metal and energy costs stay the same, so a build still waits if you cannot pay for it. Enemy AIs are unchanged. Allied Sub Commanders also build faster. Skirmish is unchanged. Edit BUILD_SPEED in ui/mods/com.pa.local.gw_fast_build/gw_play.js to go faster or slower.
